title: Docking Data
description: Apply bitmasks to values or addresses, with floating bits expanding into multiple memory writes.
writeup:
## Approach

A 36-bit bitmask is applied differently in each part. Parse with regex to extract addresses and values.

## Part 1

The mask overwrites value bits: `1` forces a bit to 1, `0` forces it to 0, `X` leaves it unchanged. Implement with an OR-mask (all `1`s in the mask) and an AND-mask (all non-`0`s in the mask). Sum all final memory values.

## Part 2

The mask is applied to the memory address instead: `1` forces a bit to 1, `0` leaves it unchanged, and `X` becomes a "floating" bit that takes both values simultaneously. Each write with `n` floating bits expands into `2^n` writes to distinct addresses. Use `itertools.product` to generate all combinations of floating bit values.
